articles.summary: More than 3.6 billion pounds of reusable goods diverted from landfills and approximately $534 million paid to nonprofit partners from fiscal 2021 through fiscal 2025 Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV) (the “Company”), the largest for-profit thrift operator in the U.S. and Canada for value-priced, pre-owned clothing, accessories and household goods, today released its 2026 Impact Sustainability Report. The fifth annual report covers the Company’s progress and performance across its environmental, social, and governance (ESG) priorities for fiscal year 2025, highlighting the power and reach of Savers Value Village’s reuse model and steps taken to enhance how it tracks and reports its impact. “Reuse is at the heart of our business, and this report shows what our model can achieve at scale,” said Mark Walsh, Chief Executive Officer of Savers Value Village. “By keeping more goods in circulation, we give our customers access to quality, affordable secondhand goods while providing
articles.title: Savers Value Village Highlights the Impact of Reuse in Fifth Annual Impact & Sustainability Report
